title: Check Tote Error on Tote Tasks (Aveva API) for the current pick up tote task
summary: Use the Tote Tasks Aveva API page to determine whether the current tote task shows a “Tote Error” value, and report the value for the task whose “Task Name” is “pick up tote.”
when_to_use: When troubleshooting tote exchange / pick-up issues and you need to verify whether the current tote task has a “Tote Error” value on the Tote Tasks Aveva API page.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Open the Tote Tasks Aveva API page, identify the row where “Task Name” is “pick up tote,” and read the “Tote Error” field value (or confirm it is blank/absent).
access_or_tools_needed: Access to the “Tote Tasks Aveva API” page/screen
Ability to view the “Tote Error” field and the associated current task row

access_required: Access to the “Tote Tasks Aveva API” page/screen

visual_references.description: Tote Tasks Aveva API page showing the Tote Task interface fields including “Task Name” and “Tote Error”.

steps.title: Open the “Tote Tasks Aveva API” page/screen
steps.purpose: Get to the Tote Tasks Aveva API interface where the current tote task fields (including “Task Name” and “Tote Error”) are displayed.
steps.instruction: Open the “Tote Tasks Aveva API” page/screen.
steps.expected_result: The Tote Tasks Aveva API page is visible and shows the Tote Task interface fields including “Task Name” and “Tote Error.”
steps.healthy_condition: The page displays the Tote Task interface with a visible “Tote Error” field area.
steps.failure_condition: The page does not show a “Tote Error” field, or the interface is not accessible/visible.

actions.label: Open Tote Tasks Aveva API page
actions.exact_action: Open the “Tote Tasks Aveva API” page/screen.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the interface does not show a “Tote Error” field, stop and escalate to L2_support.

source_evidence.quote_or_evidence: OCR text includes: “Tote Error” on the “Tote Tasks Aveva API page”.

steps.title: Locate the “Tote Error” field on the page
steps.purpose: Identify where the Tote Error value is displayed so you can read it for the correct task row.
steps.instruction: On the Tote Tasks Aveva API page, locate the “Tote Error” field.
steps.expected_result: The “Tote Error” field is visible on the Tote Task interface.
steps.healthy_condition: The “Tote Error” label/value area is present and readable on the page.
steps.failure_condition: The “Tote Error” field is blank/absent (not shown).

actions.label: Find Tote Error field
actions.exact_action: Locate the “Tote Error” field on the page.

stop_or_escalate_if: If “Tote Error” is blank/absent or the interface does not show a “Tote Error” field, stop and escalate to L2_support.

source_evidence.quote_or_evidence: OCR text includes: “Task Name … Tote Error”.

steps.title: Record the “Tote Error” value shown for the current task (if present)
steps.purpose: Capture the current tote task’s Tote Error value for reporting/troubleshooting.
steps.instruction: Read and record the “Tote Error” value shown for the current tote task row (if a value is present).
steps.expected_result: You can report whether a “Tote Error” value is present and what the value is.
steps.healthy_condition: A “Tote Error” value is displayed in the “Tote Error” field for the relevant current task row.
steps.failure_condition: The “Tote Error” field is blank/absent for the current task row.

actions.label: Read Tote Error value
actions.exact_action: Record the “Tote Error” value shown for the current task (if present).

stop_or_escalate_if: If “Tote Error” is blank/absent, stop and escalate to L2_support.

source_evidence.quote_or_evidence: OCR text shows “Tote Error” as a field on the Tote Tasks Aveva API page.

steps.title: Confirm you are reading the Tote Error associated with the “pick up tote” task
steps.purpose: Ensure the Tote Error value you record corresponds to the correct task row (Task Name = “pick up tote”).
steps.instruction: Check the “Task Name” field on the Tote Tasks Aveva API page. If “Task Name” shows “pick up tote,” confirm you are reading the “Tote Error” value from that same row.
steps.expected_result: The “Task Name” is “pick up tote,” and the recorded “Tote Error” value is from the same row as that “Task Name.”
steps.healthy_condition: A row with “Task Name” = “pick up tote” is visible, and the “Tote Error” value you report is aligned with that row.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot confirm the “Task Name” is “pick up tote,” or the “Tote Error” value you recorded is not clearly associated with the “pick up tote” row.

actions.label: Verify Task Name row
actions.exact_action: If the page shows “Task Name” as “pick up tote,” confirm you are reading the Tote Error associated with that task.

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot associate “Tote Error” with the “pick up tote” task row, stop and escalate to L2_support.

source_evidence.quote_or_evidence: Transcript near the artifact references: “tap, you know, task name, it’s pick up tote if there’s any error and of course, the tote ID,” and OCR lists “Task Name” and “Tote Error” fields.

success_criteria: You can report whether the current tote task has a “Tote Error” value and provide the value (when present).
The reported “Tote Error” value is tied to the row where “Task Name” is “pick up tote.”
healthy_conditions: Tote Tasks Aveva API page shows “Task Name” and “Tote Error” fields.
For the “pick up tote” task row, “Tote Error” is readable and can be reported.
failure_conditions: The Tote Tasks Aveva API interface does not show a “Tote Error” field.
The “Tote Error” field is blank/absent for the current task row.
You cannot confirm the “Tote Error” value corresponds to the “pick up tote” task row.
escalation_guidance: Escalate to L2_support if “Tote Error” is blank/absent or the interface does not show a “Tote Error” field (source does not provide alternate diagnostic steps or other screens).

screens_or_images.what_to_look_at: Tote Tasks Aveva API page showing the Tote Task interface fields, specifically “Task Name” and “Tote Error.”

image_refs.what_to_look_at: Tote Tasks Aveva API page showing the Tote Task interface fields, specifically “Task Name” and “Tote Error.”

missing_details: The source does not define what specific “Tote Error” values mean (only that the field exists and is checked).
